name: GeoPad
description: A web app for creating and sharing custom map data
status: abandoned (Google My Maps is similar, Simon Malls also created something similar. Neither is as good, but it would be really hard to enter the market)
features: Create public map data for property you own/manage
Emergency exits, elevators, and ramps are highlighted
Share personal map data with others
Can work with Google Maps, Apple Maps, OSM, and other map services
